📈 Price Corrections (Outliers + Entry Warmup)

Day-over-day outliers: Extreme price changes (>5x spike or >80% crash) are detected and corrected using a capped average approach.
TOTAL2 entry warmup: When a coin first enters TOTAL2, its price is capped to max +80% gain or -40% loss per day, starting from market level (TOTAL2 value). This prevents artificial spikes from coins like ZEC (27.8 BTC on day 1) or YFI (3.73 BTC after 10x growth).
